Preserve the transitive closure of retainedScriptRoots, active product tests and manual tools.

Before activating the new background template, remove retired infrastructure tests and source inputs from the diagnostic inventory with the old mechanisms. Preserve coverage reporting and partial artifacts without reviving the full tooling suite.

Keep the authored RU user changelog formatter and its used imports, but remove the old automatic announce caller at B. The new transport uses the existing release-state receipt; an uncertain send is reported and is not blindly repeated.

One invoking agent owns a release. Retry publish/complete only after its prior invocation ends; there is no separate distributed completion lock. Sequential retries resume saved side effects without tests or certification gates.

retiredTests.action: Remove with their retired mechanisms; retain behavioral parts of mixed files; inventory is migration evidence, not the permanent release allowlist

activationOrder: Explicit owner activation instruction; snapshot code, current runs, labels and exact dev/main refs; resolve actual default branch and local hook config.
Keep PROCESS_NEXT_ENABLED false and remote config.enabled false; install reviewed templates inertly on dev and event-delivery/default branch.
Drain old in-flight merge/review actions; disable old A entry workflows on both branches before enabling new coordinator. Do not cancel an unknown in-flight Git write.

Apply A hook/package/workflow replacements as one switch; initialize queue state explicitly, configure credentials and preserve established track labels. Agents choose a track only when none is assigned; track assignment does not require a new provenance gate.

Enable A after queue wakeup/finish/status and task completion retries are connected: durable review comments, S8/to_release, original-cycle milestone and latest-tree dev delivery/webhook. Observe one real authorized task; no blanket full product run is added.

Install the independent background template after removing retired mutation and diagnostic coverage inputs. It uses PROCESS_NEXT_ENABLED, rotates five mutation shards by default and reports failures in a deduplicated issue; never use it as a task or release gate.

Before B, resolve reviewed golden differences, reduce mixed dependencies, seed published beta/stable state, configure release/HACS/Telegram access and existing release-cycle classification, and preserve applicable runner cache. Keep secrets out of request JSON.

Disable old B publication/derived-review/automatic announcement callers before enabling new release commands. Apply one canonical golden runner and replace aliases; remove _service-event and announce only after every old caller is gone.

Publish only on an explicit owner release command: prepare versions and authored RU/EN text, actual membership, four assets and annotated tag. Resume the same completion path for HACS, actual S8 closure, automatic queued return to dev, exact-SHA old beta cleanup and stable Telegram. Any workflow-only main commit must also enter dev before a later release candidate.
After each stage, remove only the now-unreachable old mechanism files and their retired tests; leave manual product utilities and unrelated user hooks intact.
rollback: Disable new coordinator/fallback/review/background activation; stop accepting new queue entries and new publication commands.
Wait for or inspect any in-flight atomic push/publication; read actual refs, release assets and state. Never infer failure from a missing label/comment.

Revert only cutover code/config changes with a normal commit; restore old entry workflows and hook/package files from the recorded pre-switch revision. Do not reset dev/main or move/delete published tags.
Keep new queue/release state and runner reports for reconciliation. Already merged S8 tasks and published candidates stay completed; never replay them as unmerged work.
Reconcile unfinished tasks explicitly, then enable one coordinator family. Restore core.hooksPath only in checkouts where this cutover changed it; do not overwrite unrelated configuration.
verificationBoundary: Prepared implementation and migration manifest, with offline fakes and temporary Git repositories for side-effect paths. No workflow installation, hook replacement, live GitHub/HACS/Telegram/Opus verification, publication or activation performed. Activation requires a separate owner command; offline results do not establish live delivery.
